decks.notes: This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. It also utilizes cards like Leyline Binding and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and protect its combo pieces. The inclusion of cards like Persist and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker adds extra combo potential and flexibility to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to be creative in its strategy while still maintaining a strong combo game plan.

This aggro deck focuses on utilizing a variety of colored lands and aggressive creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By incorporating cards with multiple colors and utilizing the companion card Jegantha, the Wellspring, the deck is able to maintain a consistent and aggressive game plan. With a mix of efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial, alongside powerful threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco, this deck aims to apply early pressure and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on disruption and tempo in order to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing efficient counterspells and removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to control the board while deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Seasoned Pyromancer provide additional disruption and value. The deck's game plan revolves around disrupting the opponent's strategy while maintaining a steady stream of threats to close out the game quickly.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also putting pressure on the board with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck also utilizes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to control the board, and includes cards like Blood Moon to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect and enhance its creatures, creating a fast and disruptive aggro strategy.

The deck focuses on using aggro tactics to quickly build up Death's Shadow, a powerful creature that grows in strength as you lose life. It plays disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Counterspell to control the game and protect your threats. Murktide Regent and Drown in the Loch provide additional threats and removal, while Stubborn Denial offers protection. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and efficiently close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize. Ultimately, it seeks to control the game tempo and finish with powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to quickly pressure the opponent. It also includes disruption elements such as Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker to control the opponent's hand and graveyard. The deck utilizes cards like Terminate and Fatal Push to remove threats from the opponent's side of the field. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provide additional value and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly while disrupting their game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with the Urza lands and Eldrazi Temple to cast aggressive Eldrazi creatures like Reality Smasher and Thought-Knot Seer. It also includes disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void and Karn, the Great Creator to control the board and lock out opponents. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful threats and disruption while using efficient ramp and card selection to maintain pressure and control the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing a control strategy to maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By running a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and outvalue the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes powerful creatures such as Omnath, Locus of Creation and Nissa, Resurgent Animist to generate card advantage and pressure the opponent. With a diverse mana base and access to versatile cards like Prismatic Ending, the deck can adapt to various matchups and scenarios.

The deck revolves around using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and creating tokens with Dwarven Mine. It also incorporates a control aspect with Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to be proactive with its combos, while also having removal and protection spells like Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce. The presence of cards like Wrenn and Six and Persist adds resiliency and card advantage to the deck, making it versatile and adaptable to different situations.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker to pressure the opponent quickly. It also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Feign Death and Undying Malice allows for recursion of key creatures, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides additional card advantage. Blood Moon is included to disrupt mana bases, and Seasoned Pyromancer acts as a value generator. Overall, the deck aims to apply fast and consistent pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on using efficient creatures and removal spells to maintain pressure on the opponent. The key strategy is to play aggressive creatures like Wild Nacatl and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while supporting them with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional value to the deck. By consistently applying pressure and disrupting the opponent's game plan, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of this Merfolk aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence with powerful lords like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with disruptive creatures like Merfolk Trickster and Tide Shaper. The deck also utilizes Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play and protect them with counterspells like Force of Negation. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of resilient creatures while controlling the board with powerful Merfolk synergies.

The deck focuses on fast-paced aggressive gameplay with efficient removal and disruption spells to control the board. It utilizes low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly deal damage to the opponent while using counterspells and removal like Unholy Heat to protect its own creatures. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Expressive Iteration and Consider to maintain tempo and card advantage. The goal is to outpace the opponent and apply constant pressure to secure a quick victory.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly cycle through cards and fill the graveyard with creatures, then cast Living End to bring all those creatures back into play, possibly overwhelming the opponent with a board full of powerful creatures. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Force of Negation and Grief, while also providing alternative win conditions with cards like Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves. The deck relies on its ability to quickly set up its combo pieces and execute the Living End combo efficiently to win the game.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of cheap, efficient spells and aggressive creatures. By utilizing efficient counterspells and removal alongside powerful cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while also presenting a fast clock. The inclusion of cantrips like Consider and Mishra's Bauble helps to filter through the deck and find the necessary pieces to maintain pressure on the opponent. Moreover, land selection and resource management are crucial to ensure smooth gameplay and maximize the deck's potential.

The key concept of this deck is to use the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, and Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana and cast powerful spells. The deck focuses on controlling the game through cards like Karn Liberated and Karn, the Great Creator, as well as using board wipes like Oblivion Stone and Blast Zone to clear the opponent's threats. It also utilizes cards like Ancient Stirrings and Sylvan Scrying to search for specific lands or artifacts. Overall, the deck aims to establish a strong mana base and control the game through powerful spells and board control.
